justification: Both surfaces are upright standing slabs carrying low-relief figural imagery arranged vertically on the principal face, which is a generic monument format rather than a shared motif. A depicts an elaborate frontal standing human with headdress, ornaments, staff-like implement and dense surrounding scrollwork in a highly naturalistic, ornate manner, whereas B shows only a few sparse, schematic outline animals in profile (a quadruped above smaller creatures) on an otherwise blank field; no shared creature, attribute or relationship links them.
